plan.description: Inline immutable ARM literal-PC veneers into bounded Thumb BLX callers using their checked direct-memory fast path. Retain runtime literal reads, short budgets, stop/IRQ and original exits on a memory miss. Fixed-clock ABBA/BAAB CPU-time gameplay comparison.
